description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the composition of the “Darija Open Dataset” (version 2) across six labeled categories, with a legend on the right mapping colors to labels and numeric value labels shown inside several slices. There are 6 slices: “Translated Sentences” in yellow, labeled 45,387 (roughly about one-third of the ring); “Pending Translations” in light green, labeled 43,000 (also roughly about one-third); “Extra + Augmented Data” in blue-gray, labeled 30,000 (roughly about one-quarter); “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” in orange, a medium-sized slice with no clearly readable number label (visually around the mid-teens in percent); and two very thin slivers near the top: “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” in purple and “Moroccan Names” in salmon/orange, each appearing to be well under a few percent. No slices appear exploded or offset, and the segments are arranged around the ring without an explicitly indicated ordering rule beyond their placement.
